notes.title: Aquamarine: Explorer's Edition is here!!
notes.content:
We're going to keep this quick because today is a busy day, but yes... [url=https://twitter.com/moebial][b]Team Moebial[/b][/url] is thrilled to announce that [i][b]Aquamarine: Explorer's Edition[/b][/i] has finally arrived!

We've spent the better part of 2022 working on this game-changing update for all the players that have stuck with us from the beginning and for those who haven't yet discovered our hand-drawn alien ocean. Since the game first released, you've all given us a lot feedback, reported a ton of bugs, and shared some amazing suggestions and requests, and we've been listening and taking notes the whole time. [i][b]Aquamarine: Explorer's Edition[/b][/i] is the result of that process.

We like to think of this as [b][i]Aquamarine[/i] v2.0[/b]: We took all of your favorite parts from the game and made them better, improved the aspects that were lacking, and also added in a ton of new features and accessibility options that we've wanted to have from the start. You can check out more about the updates [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1280750/view/3392927258692428516?l=english]here[/url], or just download the game and see for yourself. :)

And here's a list of a few accessibility features and options now in [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b].
[list]
[*] All game controls are accessible on screen during gameplay
[*] Playable entirely via mouse or gamepad
[*] Extensive, replayable tutorial w/ option to repeat instructions
[*] Visual indicator for interactable objects
[*] Tool-tips for in-game controls
[*] HUD size options
[*] Multiple difficulty options, including a "story mode" that removes death and enemy damage
[*] Supports windowed mode
[*] Particle amount options
[*] Screen shake toggle
[*] Grid shape toggle
[*] Cursor speed controls for gamepad
[*] Music & sound FX volume controls
[*] All options settings carry over between saves
[*] Distinct sound & music cues for objects and events
[*] Controls & UI elements are large and well spaced out
[*] No information is conveyed only through color
[/list]
That just about covers everything. We're so thrilled for you to dive into this new version of [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b], and we really hope you enjoy what we've done.

Please take a second to give us a review (or update your review) once you've spent some time with the [b][i]Explorer's Edition[/i][/b]. We always love hearing your comments and feedback!

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.title: Aquamarine: Explorer's Edition arrives November 22!
notes.content:
[b][url=https://twitter.com/moebial]Team Moebial[/url][/b] is absolutely thrilled to announce the arrival of our game-changing new edition of [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b], which arrives as a free update on November 22!

[previewyoutube=DipdYwKMObI;full][/previewyoutube]

Some of you may remember last month when we detailed what [b][i]Aquamarine: Explorer's Edition[/i][/b] will bring to the game, and you can read all about those upcoming features [url=https://steamcommunity.com/games/1280750/announcements/detail/3290466471532809071]here[/url]. Some of the biggest changes you can expect include:

[list]
[*] Overall [b]difficulty has been refined and balanced[/b] for multiple game modes, including NORMAL, RELAXED, EXPLORE, and EXPERT
[*] [b]New game mode EXPLORE[/b] introduces the option to safely experience the world & story without consequences
[*] [b]New game mode EXPERT[/b] introduces a "hardcore" difficulty option for those looking for a serious test of their survival skills and knowledge of the planet's ecosystem
[*] A [b]brand-new save system[/b] has been added, giving players three individual save slots to load and reset as they wish
[*] [b]Multiple accessibility options[/b] have been added, including an optional tool-tip system that explains the functions of each of control
[*] [b]New environment art and creature animations[/b] have been added to each exploration area
[*] [b]Localization has been added[/b] in English, French, Spanish, Chinese (Simplified), and Thai
[*] [b]Full gamepad support[/b] has been added
[*] Plus tons of bug fixes, polish updates, performance optimizations, and much more...
[/list]
We'll be celebrating this new version of [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b] with a big sale, so make sure to check back here next week and discover what the Explorer's Edition is all about!

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.title: The Future of Aquamarine is Just Around the Corner...
notes.content:
Hello, Seekers!

It's been a long and eventful summer for everyone at [url=https://twitter.com/moebial]Moebial Studios[/url], as we've been balancing big life changes with our non-stop work on updating [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b] and getting it ready for consoles. So much has happened over here, I figured it was time to finally let everyone know what we've got cooking!

After my partner and I settled into our new life with our adorable baby boy (he's 6 months old now!), I got straight to work on a brand-new, "enhanced" version of [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b]. This comprehensive revamp will be the version we release on consoles, and will also be immediately available as a free update on PC. I've been looking at this as [b][i]Aquamarine[/i] v2.0[/b], because it greatly expands the game's features and addresses a huge amount of the player feedback we've received since launch. 

Here's a quick rundown of what's been changed and added...

[list]
[*] Overall difficulty has been refined and balanced for multiple game modes, including [b]NORMAL[/b], [b]RELAXED[/b], [b]EXPLORE[/b], and [b]EXPERT[/b]
[*] New game mode [b]EXPLORE[/b] introduces the option to safely experience [i][b]Aquamarine[/b][/i]'s world & story without consequences
[*] New game mode [b]EXPERT[/b] introduces a "hardcore" difficulty option for those looking for a serious test of their survival skills and knowledge of the planet's ecosystem
[*] A brand-new save system has been added, giving players three individual save slots to load and reset as they wish
[*] Multiple new features have been added to the underwater survival pod, including an optional tool-tip system that explains the functions of each of control when you hover over it
[*] The system behind all story events, visions, and dreams has been recalibrated for continuity, clarity, and consistency
[*] New environment art and creature animations have been added to each exploration area
[*] New rare gem power-ups can now be found hidden through each exploration area
[*] Day/night cycle system has been reworked mechanically and visually
[*] Multiple creature AI have been updated across all game modes
[*] New functionality has been added to the island camp and garden, including the ability to use your tools by selecting them directly on screen
[*] New functionality has been added to the controls, including the ability to cancel out of any action with a single button press
[*] Game options now include windowed/fullscreen view toggle, three bespoke resolutions, HUD size options, and more
[*] Game is fully localized for all platforms in [b]English[/b], [b]French[/b], [b]Spanish[/b], [b]Chinese (Simplified)[/b], and [b]Thai[/b]
[*] A new pod color scheme and [b]EXPERT[/b] mode are unlocked after finishing the game
[/list]
And that's not to mention the countless bug fixes and bits of visual/mechanical polish that's been done along the way. Suffice it to say that this next update for [i][b]Aquamarine[/b][/i] changes the game in a major way, and I am thrilled to be able to share it with you.

In the meantime, keep your eyes peeled for more announcements and release dates...

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.title: v1.1.0 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

It's been nearly a month since our last update post, but the longer wait was only because I've been working on [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b]'s biggest update yet. The [b]v1.1.0[/b] patch is the result of an extensive QA audit, months of community feedback, internal playtesting, and preparations for console porting. I think you'll find the gameplay experience more polished and immersive than ever before.

The biggest headline here is that [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b] now offers full gamepad support, specifically for [b]PS4[/b], [b]Xbox One[/b], [b]Xbox Series X[/b], and other third-party gamepads. But that's far from all that's gone into this update. Check out the extensive list of what's in [b]v1.1.0[/b] below.

[u][b]v1.1.0 Patch Notes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added gamepad support for PS4, Xbox One, and Xbox Series X controllers, as well as third-party gamepads
[*] Balanced resource collection and spawning mechanics for each difficulty; playing on "Normal" no longer results in a large surplus of energy and food
[*] Balanced plant spawning mechanics to align more with the environmental cycles
[*] Tutorial now continues from where the player left off if the game quits during the tutorial
[*] Cursor now becomes unusable during cutscenes and loading screens
[*] Decreased time between the player turn and the creature/environment turn
[*] Rewrote and removed some of the pod hints
[*] Added another speech bubble prompt to an environmental puzzle
[*] Fixed a bug causing a soft-lock when the pod is attacked by a Grabber creautre
[*] Fixed a bug causing whirlpools to not always trigger their effects
[*] Fixed a bug causing clouds to not proper de-spawn in The Coral Woods
[*] Fixed a bug causing items to disappear off the island if the player never built the driftwood shelter
[*] Fixed a bug causing the pod scanner to not trigger when charged
[*] Fixed a bug causing creature corpses to not spawn properly
[*] Fixed a bug causing some items to not immediately leave the inventory when used in the island garden
[*] Fixed a visual glitch causing the power meter in the island mod menu to not properly update its color when overloaded
[*] Fixed a visual glitch causing the pod sprite to flicker with a certain upgrade enabled
[*] Fixed a visual glitch causing text in the game ending to be hard to read
[*] Made a variety of other small visual fixes and tweaks
[/list]
Trust me when I say that list isn't even everything. And of course we're still always on the lookout for any more issues. The quickest way to report a bug and have it fixed is through our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?url=https://discord.gg/H4F3wws]Discord[/url].

Last but not least, I wanted to let everyone know that the official [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1872020/Aquamarine_Soundtrack/][b][i]Aquamarine OST[/i][/b][/url] is now available on Steam! This incredible soundtrack was written and produced entirely by our composer [url=https://thomashoey.bandcamp.com/]Thomas Hoey[/url], and the work he did turning the game music into these 17 ambient pieces is just gorgeous. Please give it a listen and consider picking up your own copy on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1872020/Aquamarine_Soundtrack/]Steam[/url].

Til next time!

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.title: v1.0.8.6 Quick Fix Patch Notes
notes.content:
Things have been a little quiet around here the past couple of weeks, while my partner and I took time away from work for the birth of our first child. We now have a happy and healthy baby boy in our life, and couldn't feel more blessed. And maybe a little bit exhausted. :)

Thanks to everyone for being patient with us during this busy time in my life. I'm now ready to resume [i][b]Aquamarine[/b][/i]'s regular updates as per usual. To start off, here's a patch of quick fixes for some recent bug reports we received. Details below.

[u][b]v1.0.8.6 Patch Notes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing creatures to sometimes move onto the same tile as the player
[*] Fixed a bug causing some pod upgrades to not properly detect interactable objects
[*] Fixed a bug causing some objects to not properly highlight when interactable
[*] Fixed a bug causing some environment updates to not properly resolve
[*] Fixed a visual issue causing the player sprite to flicker
[*] Made other small visual updates
[/list]
Please continue to share any issues you might find in our [url=https://discord.gg/H4F3wws]Discord[/url], so they can be tracked down and fixed immediately. And keep your eyes out for our next big update: gamepad support!

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.content:
[h3]Edit: v1.0.8.5 now includes another pass of fixes for the day/night cycle and environment system. Fixes have also been made for a bug causing the Light Mod to not properly initialize, and for some dreams to appear even without sleeping.[/h3]

With [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b]'s first ever sale now underway, we've made a small number of fixes and updates to make sure everyone's experience is the best it can be.

A few lingering bugs that have shown up for some players have been addressed, and one mechanical system in particular has been revamped. Details below.

[u][b]v1.0.8.4 Quick Fix Patch Notes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing clouds to not spawn and animate properly in the first area
[*] Fixed a bug causing a softlock after selecting the length of time for camping
[*] Revamped the creature corpse system, corpses now remain in their original state until dark
[*] Revamped the day/night cycle color transitions in the exploration areas
[*] Revamped mechanics and graphics for the pod scanning system
[/list]
Keep an eye out for gamepad support in the near future!

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.content:

[list]
[*] Added functionality to tutorial, allowing the pod to repeat its previous instructions when needed
[*] Added ability to use a late game pod upgrade on the final puzzle of the last area
[*] Balanced item spawning in certain map sections of the first area
[*] Fixed a bug causing softlocks when exiting and reloading the tutorial
[*] Fixed a bug causing inconsistent mouse cursor changes during the tutorial
[*] Fixed a bug causing the pod scanner to not properly activate or remain persistent across dives
[*] Fixed a bug causing some creatures to move onto occupied spaces
[*] Fixed a bug causing the pod map menu to not update properly with a certain rare item
[*] Fixed a number of visual bugs & inconsistencies
[*] Made a number of visual & performance optimizations
[/list]
As always, there's much more packed into this update, but those are the main bullet points. More coming soon!

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.title: Aquamarine v1.0.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]EDIT: A new quick fix has been uploaded to address two issues. One for a bug causing the keyboard arrows to not pull up the HUD, and one for a bug causing a freeze when quitting then reloading a level from the start screen.[/h3]

Been a little while since our last update, as we've been hard at work getting [i]Aquamarine[/i] ported to console. But during that part of development we've also made a number of updates to the game overall, including optimizations, fixes, new options, and more. Coolest of all, we've finally got a nice batch of achievements ready for everyone to hunt down. Check out the details of this latest patch below.

[u][b]v1.0.7 Patch Notes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Added 20 Steam achievements, including 8 hidden ones
[*] Added an option for pod HUD size
[*] Added functionality for checking the health/status of plants in the garden
[*] Added functionality for pushing blocks created by the pod
[*] Added a visual hint for a puzzle in the Drowned Harbor
[*] Added a prompt for minimizing speech bubbles during the tutorial
[*] Fixed a bug causing freezes when loading dense map areas
[*] Fixed a bug causing softlocks when opening & closing the pod menus too quickly
[*] Fixed a bug interfering with selecting items in the pod inventory
[*] Fixed a bug causing the pod to not regenerate on the island during the tutorial
[*] Fixed a bug causing some scenery sprites not to spawn on the map
[*] Made a handful of visual tweaks & fixes
[*] Made a handful of loading and exploration optimizations
[/list]

Those are the major bits in this update, and we already have a few planned for the next one. Gamepad support should be coming soon, at least a stripped-down version of it. Keep your eyes on this space!

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.title: Aquamarine v1.0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h3]EDIT: New quick patch added that addresses problems with some users experiencing a crash when loading Area Two. A fix was also made for a bug causing one pod upgrade to not activate properly.[/h3]

As we near the two-week anniversary of [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b]'s release, the game continues to be updated regularly. This latest patch is another big one, with a bunch of important bug fixes and some even more important changes to resource balance and mechanics. Check out the main points below:

[u][b]v1.0.6 Patch Notes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing an upgrade item to spawn in the wrong place
[*] Fixed a bug causing some tiles in the final area to become unusable
[*] Fixed a bug causing softlocks in the final area when certain environment effects appeared
[*] Fixed a bug causing an upgrade ability to incorrectly highlight objects out of range
[*] Fixed a bug causing an environmental puzzle to not spawn properly
[*] Fixed a bug causing some environmental puzzles to not open properly
[*] Fixed a bug causing certain upgrade items to be uncollectable
[*] Fixed a bug causing multiple upgrades to be activated simultaneously
[*] Fixed a bug causing some corpses to not update properly
[*] Fixed a bug causing some corpses not to spawn
[*] Fixed a bug causing softlocks when the pod gained or lost a move
[*] Fixed a number of visual inconsistencies & small code errors
[*] Added a spot on the ground beneath light shafts to make them easier to see
[*] Added more resource spawns to the final area when first entering
[*] Changed the pod upgrades to now gain a charge when collecting any gem
[*] Changed the gardening mechanics to now allow plants to grow faster
[*] Updated the end credits to scroll more quickly & be skippable
[/list]
That should be it for this new batch of updates. Now reaching the end of the game should be a lot smoother for everyone. Good luck!

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.title: Aquamarine v1.0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Another day, another update for [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b]!

This batch of fixes and gameplay tweaks isn't quite as big as our previous update, but that's a good thing. We're running out of major issues to solve! What that means for players is we're able to turn our attention towards adding features and calibrating resource & difficulty balance. We think you'll dig what's in this latest version.

[b][u]v1.0.4 Patch Notes[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing softlocks after quitting in the middle of the tutorial
[*] Fixed a bug effecting audio capabilities on Linux
[*] Fixed a bug causing the inventory to overload and become unusable
[*] Fixed a bug causing the garden flower to sometimes disappear
[*] Fixed a bug causing incorrect sprites to appear on some corpses
[*] Added an option to change resolution/window size
[*] Altered gem mechanics according to difficulty, each gem now provides more energy on lower difficulties
[*] Added the ability to check pod's fuel & hull amounts by clicking it on the island
[*] Items are no longer permanently removed when washed away by the current
[*] Updated a handful of visual elements
[/list]
Short and sweet! We've been getting some fantastic feedback from our players on [url=https://discord.gg/H4F3wws]Discord[/url], and have already began incorporating their feedback into the game. Come drop us a line and let us know what you think the game needs to improve the experience. We can't wait to hear from you!

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.title: Aquamarine v1.0.3 Now Live!
notes.content:
After another few days of feedback and bug report collecting, we've just published [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b]'s most substantial update yet with v1.0.3. This latest version includes a number of major bug fixes, changes to some core mechanics, balance tweaks for resources and difficulty, and more. Check out the full list below.

[u][b]v1.0.3 Patch Notes[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed issues with incorrect text spacing during the tutorial and other pod dialog
[*] Fixed issues with the wrong text displaying in tutorial messages
[*] Fixed issues with buttons being usable at wrong times during the tutorial
[*] Changed long-range engine mechanics: Function can now be used anywhere on the map at any time
[*] Added a prompt during the tutorial to learn how to repair your pod, also modified repair costs according to difficulty
[*] Boosted starting energy values for pod's fuel and hull, which vary depending on difficulty
[*] Pod now automatically recharges hull with gem reserves after reaching zero during player turn
[*] Recharging your pod after it breaks now also gives you three upgrade charges
[*] Fixed issues with selecting map locations and confirming travel in the fast travel menu
[*] Added a hint dialog for a puzzle in the second area
[*] Fixed an issue with shifting depth in certain sections of the second area
[*] Fixed a bug causing softlocks while camping
[*] Fixed issues with certain upgrade animations
[*] Fixed a bug causing crashes due to game assets missing on some computers
[*] Intro screen and cutscene now replay when restarting
[*] Various visual updates & polish
[/list]
Those are our major fixes for this update. If you find anything else, let us know in the [b][i]Aquamarine[/i][/b] [url=https://discord.gg/H4F3wws]Discord[/url]! We're also chatting over hints and tips for anyone who is stumped on a puzzle, or just looking for pointers on how to navigate this alien ocean.

Til next update!

🌊👁🌐
[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.title: Aquamarine Day Two Update!
notes.content:
[h2][strike]EDIT: There was an error while uploading this build and we've had to roll it back to v1.0.1 for the time being. The next update will be re-published on Sunday, January 23. Thanks for your patience.[/strike][/h2]

Happy day after release day!

Just want to quickly say how much we appreciate the feedback we've been getting from our players, both on Discord and in the comments. Even the negative reviews! We are here to listen and regularly address your concerns. We appreciate everyone who is continuing to follow our progress, and especially those who are sending their constructive feedback. Now, let's talk bug fixes!

Here's what's in this latest build:
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug allowing players to use the long-range engine while on the water's surface
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped the pod from breaking the gem during the tutorial
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a crash when using the Bash upgrade on certain creatures
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed items on the map to be moved underneath creatures
[*] Fixed a bug that stopped the pod from using the Bash upgrade on certain creature corpses
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed the pod to use the Block upgrade in wrong location 
[*] Fixed a bug that caused a softlock during creature's movement
[*] Fixed a bug allowing you to confirm fast travel even when unavailable 
[*] Fixed a bug breaking some upgrade animations
[*] Fixed a number of visual bugs & inconsistencies
[/list]
Chances are that list doesn't even cover all of the changes that were made, but it's most of them! And of course there are more updates to come next week.

We hope you'll keep checking back and sharing your feedback with us. We are listening and working hard to make Aquamarine the best experience it can be.

🌊👁🌐
- Team Moebial

notes.title: Aquamarine Day One Update Now Live!
notes.content:
Happy release day everyone!

It's been a crazy, amazing whirlwind of a day for us, and seeing all the excitement and enthusiasm for Aquamarine from our friends & fans has made it so incredible. We've been watching your streams and chatting with you on [url=https://discord.gg/H4F3wws]Discord[/url], so we've caught a few issues that needed fixing.

It's very important to us that we're always listening to our players and making Aquamarine the best it can be. So even in the middle of a hectic release day, we've put together a patch of quick fixes and balance updates for everyone. Check it out:

[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with map spawning causing crashes in the Coral Woods
[*] Fixed an issue with the pod menu graphic freezing on screen
[*] Fixed an issue with crashes caused when traveling from the Coral Woods to the island
[*] Reduced the cost of traveling to the island from certain areas on the map
[*] Reduced the cost of upgrade modules from 25 & 40 to 20 & 30
[*] Fixed various small errors & code exceptions
[/list]

Those all the major points covered in v1.0.1, but please be sure to let us know if you run into any other issues. Drop a comment here or just hop in our [url=https://discord.gg/H4F3wws]Discord[/url]! We're only a tiny team of developers, with only one programmer, and Aquamarine is a large and complicated place. But we'll always make sure to listen and address the feedback and comments from our players.

So take a dive and see what you can find hidden in these waters! And once you've spent some time in this world, please leave us a review. They're such a massive help in Aquamarine gaining exposure.

Thanks everyone!

🌊👁🌐

[b]- Team Moebial[/b]

notes.title: Feedback from our Beta Playtest
notes.content:
[h2]Hi there, Seafarers![/h2]

We’d like to send a heartfelt THANK YOU to everyone who played in our open beta over the past few days via our Discord and Steam communities. Don’t forget: If you activated the beta playtest branch by Sunday, Dec. 12th, you’ll still be able to play and create content for now!

Our goal with Aquamarine is to make a survival game that is uniquely serene and contemplative. Your feedback has confirmed our direction, and inspired us to pursue new and optimized ways to achieve that experience.

[h2]What You Loved[/h2]
[h3]Our animation sequences, graphics, and soundtrack
[/h3]
We’re so glad that this alien world has struck a heartstring with you all already. Here are some things our playtesters had to say:
[i]“The soundtrack is wonderful and the graphics are really good,” -BlueCritter
“Game's beautiful, everything looks very professional and polished,” -LyonSyonII
“Soundtrack is soooo gorgeous!” -SuperKimVT[/i]
[h3]Aquamarine’s alien water planet environment[/h3]
Players reported becoming enthralled by Aquamarine’s various environment areas and aquatic critters. Too dang cute.
[i]“The creatures look and sound great. These are real creatures of an alien planet,”- Nova
“The map was easy to understand and I love how it unravels as you explore.” -VIRVA[/i]
[h3]The story[/h3]
No spoilers here! Exploration, collection, and plain survival contributes to the progression of Aquamarine’s story. We’re so glad you’ve enjoyed uncovering more and more.

   [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37277010/9000b877870781c0c4ae915ae0a73e1e3a117275.gif[/img]

[h2]What We're Improving[/h2]
[h3]Tutorial intent/clarity[/h3]
Many players reported feeling overwhelmed and confused about survival pod mechanics. Our tutorial includes many answers to common questions about gameplay, but we need to implement a way for the player to look over the tutorial guides more than once.
[i]“There were a lot of mechanic instructions at the beginning and it was so overwhelming for me,” -VIRVA
“After you understand every switch, of course everything is easy, but getting started is tricky,” - Nova[/i]
[h3]HUD & mechanics clarity[/h3]
Players reported confusion over matching game mechanics to controls, relating to tutorial repeatability
[h3]A handful of new bug popups that you’ve helped us identify[/h3]
Bugs, begone!

[h2]Overall Feedback[/h2]
[i]“Wow, I was enraptured by this game. Seriously great work,” -kez_liquescent
“The game becomes even more beautiful with each update!” -shade
“ I'm already invested in the game thanks to the fantastic art and story-telling/setting,” VIRVA[/i]

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]
	We’ve started fixing, improving, and polishing Aquamarine based on your feedback during our beta playtest. Our next big plan will be circling back to you with new updates on Aquamarine’s development and, perhaps, a release date(!) soon.
	Join our community of Seafarers in the meantime over on Discord, and thank you again for a successful playtest! See you in the waters.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1280750/Aquamarine/
